answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in summit, expire in meadow, and knoll lists each expiry. An farming party running 30 aliases as a result needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 90 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
